obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be in "free flight" at the moment of impact, at the required impact velocity (as specified in paragraphs 4.6. and 5.6. below) and the required direction of impact (as specified in paragraphs 4.7. and 5.7. below)
obligations.ears: When the headform test is performed, the headform impactors shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact, at the required impact velocity (as specified in paragraphs 4.6. and 5.6. below) and the required direction of impact (as specified in paragraphs 4.7. and 5.7. below).

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be released to "free flight" at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor
obligations.ears: When the headform test is performed, the impactors shall be released to "free flight" at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during rebound of the impactor.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be measured at some point during the free flight before impact, in accordance with the method specified in ISO 3784:1976
obligations.ears: When the headform test is performed, the velocity of the headform impactor shall be measured at some point during the free flight before impact, in accordance with the method specified in ISO 3784:1976.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be adjusted considering all factors which may affect the impactor between the point of measurement and the point of impact, in order to determine the velocity of the impactor at the time of impact
obligations.ears: When the headform test is performed, the measured velocity shall be adjusted considering all factors which may affect the impactor between the point of measurement and the point of impact, in order to determine the velocity of the impactor at the time of impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.ears: When the headform test is performed, the angle of the velocity vector at the time of impact shall be calculated or measured.

obligations.subject: e24
obligations.response: The acceleration time histories shall be recorded, and HIC shall be calculated
obligations.ears: When the headform test is performed, the acceleration time histories shall be recorded, and HIC shall be calculated.

derived.text: When the headform test is performed, the acceleration time histories shall be recorded.
When the headform test is performed, HIC shall be calculated.

obligations.subject: e22
obligations.ears: When the headform test is performed, the measuring point on the front structure of the vehicle shall be recorded.
When the headform test is performed, recording of test results shall be in accordance with ISO 6487:2002.

obligations.subject: e11
obligations.response: identify the zones of the bonnet top test area and of the windscreen test area where the HIC shall not exceed 1,000 (HIC1000 zone) or 1,700 (HIC1700 zone)
obligations.ears: The manufacturer shall identify the zones of the bonnet top test area and of the windscreen test area where the HIC shall not exceed 1,000 (HIC1000 zone) or 1,700 (HIC1700 zone) (see Figure 5).

obligations.response: A sufficient number of x and y co-ordinates shall be supplied by the manufacturer to mark up the areas on the actual vehicle while considering the vehicle outer contour in the z direction
obligations.ears: The manufacturer shall supply a sufficient number of x and y co-ordinates to mark up the areas on the actual vehicle while considering the vehicle outer contour in the z direction.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: may consist of several parts, with the number of these parts not being limited
obligations.ears: The areas of "HIC1000 zone" and "HIC1700 zone" may consist of several parts, with the number of these parts not being limited.

obligations.subject: e11
obligations.response: be done on the basis of a projected bonnet and windscreen when viewed from a horizontal plane parallel to the horizontal zero plane above the vehicle, on the basis of the drawing data supplied by the manufacturer
obligations.ears: The calculation of the surface of the bonnet top test area and the calculation of the surface of the windscreen test area as well as the surface areas of "HIC1000 zone" and "HIC1700 zone" shall be done on the basis of a projected bonnet and windscreen when viewed from a horizontal plane parallel to the horizontal zero plane above the vehicle, on the basis of the drawing data supplied by the manufacturer.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: less than nine tests for each impactor may be performed
obligations.exception: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 4.2. and 5.2. below
obligations.ears: When a number of measuring points have been selected in order of potential to cause injury and the test area remaining is too small to select another measuring point while maintaining the minimum spacing between points, less than nine tests for each impactor may be performed.

obligations.response: be indicated in the test report
obligations.ears: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.

obligations.subject: e24
obligations.response: perform as many tests as necessary to guarantee the compliance of the vehicle with the head injury criteria (HIC) limit values of 1,000 for the HIC1000 zone and 1,700 for the HIC1700 zone, especially in the points near to the borders between the two types of zones
obligations.ears: The technical services conducting the tests shall perform as many tests as necessary to guarantee the compliance of the vehicle with the head injury criteria (HIC) limit values of 1,000 for the HIC1000 zone and 1,700 for the HIC1700 zone, especially in the points near to the borders between the two types of zones.
